title: A third-party trainer died in 113 seconds for three independent reasons
symptom: The run failed immediately with a path like /Mamba-YOLO//ocean/.../cwd12_sealed.yaml.
root_cause: The fork prefixes every path argument with ROOT; its task dispatch is a dict literal so all three branches evaluate eagerly and YOLO has no .test(); and it exposes no --seed, which would have left the family unable to report mean+/-std.
correction_made: Call the fork's vendored ultralytics API directly from its directory, fixing all three at once and giving Mamba the same seeded protocol as the other families; a 25-minute smoke job gated the full runs.
